title: Group expense splitter
goal: Build an expense splitter web app for a group. The page has a text input with the placeholder "Member name" and a button labelled "Add member". Each member is listed with their balance: "NAME: +$X" when they are owed money, "NAME: -$X" when they owe money and "NAME: $0.00" otherwise, with X shown with two decimals. Below, there is a text input with the placeholder "Expense", a text input with the placeholder "Amount" (whole dollars) and, for each member, a button labelled "Paid by NAME". Clicking one stores an expense with the typed description and amount, paid by that member and split equally among all members there are at that moment, and clears both inputs. A balance is what the member paid minus the sum of their shares. Stored expenses are listed as "DESCRIPTION: $AMOUNT paid by NAME", each with a button labelled "Delete DESCRIPTION" that removes it from the server; balances follow every change. The server stores the members and, for each expense, its description, amount, payer and the members it is split among. Stored members, expenses and balances are shown when the page loads and kept when the server restarts.
